summary: Time-limited, schema-aware log excerpt provisioning for data subpoena response
description:
Issue summary: External counsel served a narrow data subpoena for a single customer (Acme Robotics) covering requests made between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-30. Legal has requested a targeted, schema-aware excerpt of inference request/response logs that match specific identifiers and event types, with PII redacted.

Request details: Counsel requires fields: request_id, timestamp, customer_id (hashed), model_name, route, prompt_schema (top-level keys only), redacted_output_snippet (first 256 chars), and delivery metadata (region, node_id). They asked for a small, conjoined CSV/JSONL extract keyed by request_id and explicitly forbade full session dumps.

Legal context: Subpoena delivered to Legal on 2026-03-12; matter is active. Legal (A. Patel) confirmed scope by email: only inference logs tied to customer_id=ACME-1729 and a short list of email identifiers. Dual signoff from Security + Legal is required before any extract leaves internal storage.

Constraints & safeguards: Output must have PII redacted or deterministically hashed via KMS-wrapped key (HMAC-SHA256). No free-text full responses allowed — only first 256 characters of generated output, with pattern-based redaction for emails, phone numbers, API keys, and any sequence resembling private keys. Access window must be 48 hours; logs to be staged to a secure S3 bucket with bucket-level ACLs and object-level encryption (KMS). All access must be logged and multi-party approved via the privileged-access workflow.

Extraction method requested: Schema-aware filter to parse JSON payloads rather than raw grep; apply JSONPath selectors to pull only approved top-level keys and nested 'prompt.metadata' fields. Prefer using existing 'log-extract-tool' pipeline with a redaction transform module rather than ad-hoc queries.

Expected deliverables: (1) A redacted JSONL file (UTF-8) no larger than 50MB, (2) an extraction runbook describing selectors and redaction regexes, (3) audit log of who ran the job and KMS key IDs used, (4) checksum (sha256) of delivered file.

Risk assessment: Medium — possibility of inadvertent PII leakage if redaction patterns miss edge cases in generated outputs. Security to perform validation on a 100-row sample before final handoff.

Next steps requested from Eng/SRE: (1) Confirm feasibility and ETA for a schema-aware extraction using the 'redaction-service' pipeline, (2) nominate an operator for the dual-control staging, (3) provide sample of redacted rows for security review, (4) stage final artifact to legal-approved bucket and notify Legal.

Additional notes: Customer support/CS must not be contacted directly for this subpoena; all customer communication to be routed through Legal. Do not change retention policies as part of this ticket.
steps_to_reproduce: This is a request workflow rather than a bug. Repro steps for the pipeline: 1) Spin up extraction job in 'log-extract-tool' with JSONPath selectors; 2) Apply redaction transform with KMS HMAC hashing for customer_id/email fields; 3) Run on a time-bounded window (2025-09-01 to 2025-09-30); 4) Produce JSONL artifact and run security validation script 'sec-validate-redaction.sh' against sample; 5) If OK, stage file to s3://legal-subpoena-exports/INT-246801/ with server-side-encryption=kms and set ACL=private + bucket policy limiting IPs.
